lines.text: CampusConnect
We make campus commuting simple!
What we offer
Transit Schedules: Access comprehensive campus shuttle and bus
timetables. Dynamic itinerary recalibration helps you get to your
next class or club meeting on time.
Rideshare and Bikeshare Availability: Compare prices and wait
times across platforms. Map pinpoints your exact location relative
to nearby vehicles.
Campus Traffic: Instantly receive notifications about roadblocks,
construction zones, and detours. Synthesizing data from campus
transportation services and student-generated reports maintains
accuracy.
User-Friendly Interface: Designed for diverse groups, from
first-year students to faculty. Save frequently visited locations such
as dorms, libraries, and lecture halls. Customizable notification
settings empower users to tailor alerts according to specific
categories of information and desired time intervals.
Commitment to Excellence: Our team monitors user feedback to
refine app functionality. In a relentless pursuit of innovation,
CampusConnect evolves together with the communities it serves.
Click here to download CampusConnect today!
